text:
Maya: quick heads-up — Nightjar needs a short peering + route-level throughput override for an APAC sales demo next Wed 15:00 SGT. They want ~600 qps for ~45m. Also asked to schedule a renewal touch after the pilot.
Rachel: CSM checking in 1 — trial ends in ~2.5 weeks, renewal risk if demo underperforms. I'll own the follow-up.
Ethan: which APAC region and CIDRs do we need? TLS proxy or passthrough?
Maya: want ap-southeast-1. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/25 (app), 203.0.113.128/28 (dev). Proxy required (observability).
Priya: I'll get billing approval. billing@nightjar.ai is the contact. I'll open a Zendesk ticket and capture approval.
Jordan: infra can provision peering + route pin. prefer to pin just the route /v1/chat/completions. They requested 14-day logs retention 14d. Any objections?
Maya: 14 days is fine for this pilot. Important: token-level override needed so their dev tokens don't hit org limits.
Ethan: confirm we need a control-plane rate override (route+token). Priya can you add approval note in the ticket?
Priya: done 1 — Zendesk NZ-9205 created, approval email archived. Enablement call set for Wed 13:30 SGT (invite sent).
InfraBot: Deploy plan created: peering/nightjar-ap-southeast-1-3500001111. Runbook: /runbooks/peering-temp. Auto-revoke job scheduled for 2025-05-14T07:05:00Z.
Jordan: I'll apply ACL/route pin. Example config we'll push:
```json
{
  "customer": "nightjar",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "routes": ["/v1/chat/completions"],
  "cidrs": ["203.0.113.0/25","203.0.113.128/28"],
  "temporary": true,
  "window": {"start": "2025-05-12T06:00:00Z", "end": "2025-05-14T06:45:00Z"},
  "qps_override": 600,
  "log_retention_days": 14
}
```
Jordan: will also pre-warm KV cache for key prefixes. Running warmup after peering:
```bash
./scripts/prewarm.sh --host nightjar-proxy.ap-southeast-1 --prefixes nightjar-prefixes.txt --rate 250 --duration 600
```
Jordan: applying now, will post when complete.
Jordan: DONE 1 1peering live, route pinned, qps override active. Audit logs: https://console.redwood/ops/logs?ticket=NZ-9205
Maya: excellent. Rachel 1 let's do post-demo health check 24h after: capture p95, error rate, token cost delta, and any customer notes for renewal pack.
Rachel: on it. I'll run the health check and add notes to the renewal playbook + tag AE for upsell follow-up.
Ethan: FYI ops note: remember to revoke overrides automatically and verify auto-revoke job succeeded.
InfraBot: Auto-revoke scheduled and will emit event to #eng-sre when done.
Maya: thanks team 44d I'll update Nightjar thread and close once Rachel confirms post-demo metrics.
